profile_text.body:
Micron Technology Inc is a public company headquartered in Boise, Idaho, trading under the ticker MU, with its website at micron.com. It describes itself as a global leader in memory and storage, powering AI and compute-intensive applications from cloud to edge with semiconductor solutions.

On its own site, the company ties its memory and storage products to AI, saying mobile memory and storage accelerate AI-driven technologies that enable predictive, insightful and new experiences for end users. The site offers data sheets, design tools and technical documentation, an online source for placing and tracking orders for Micron memory samples, sales support contact, and enrollment in Micron's Technology Enablement Program (TEP).

The record holds no tracked products, no MCP servers and no lawsuits for the company. Its litigation exposure is recorded in Idaho, with a count of 21. It is registered with the SEC under CIK 0000723125.
